description: Election Commission - Declare that R. Suventhera was Selected as the member of the Vavuniya South (Tamil) Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to resignations and party membership changes.
